provenance.reported: Data-owner circuit/geometry note: 1 kohm, 100 V sweep battery, 40.5 V fast bias, 0.5 mm diameter, 2.5 mm exposed length, Te=9.17 eV.
provenance.confirmed_geometry: Data owner, 2026-10-29: C1 is the left fixed probe in the supplied diagram; C3 is the other probe, 3.7 mm to the right. This is not a measured propagation direction.
provenance.shunt_polarity: Assume stored CH4_2 equals tip-minus-clip voltage as drawn, with no additional inversion. An increasing electron-positive branch supports this convention but does not independently calibrate polarity.
provenance.estimated: Cathode/chamber offset=0 V, effective capacitance=100 pF, relative gain=1 and delay=0 ns are provisional modelling inputs, not measurements. Scenario ranges are illustrative, not confidence bounds or guaranteed limits.
provenance.scope: Primary sweeps and fast captures are treated as representative of comparable plasma for the bias scenarios only; they are not simultaneous. Additional sweeps remain a separate group. No measured high-frequency data are deconvolved.
